doctrine_lessons_recorded: When minting a tranche-level board (e.g. codex-tranche-2-7), the FIRST action must be to create the tranche branch on origin from develop, push it, and configure CI/protection. This is devops/tranche-branch-governance step 1.
Without the tranche branch existing, the slice workers will default to develop because that's the only branch available in their worktree.
Mint-time body fields like branch: develop or base_sha: develop@c78287c are red flags if the corresponding tranche branch does not exist.

The fix for slice-PRs-opening-on-develop-by-default is to (a) create the tranche branch first, (b) update card bodies to name the tranche branch, (c) post comments explaining the correction, (d) document the procedure in the tranche README so future sessions don't repeat the mistake.
